source: Creator-supplied Capricorn man x Aries woman carousel, repaired through A Story carousel gates.
selector_verdict: GO. Preserve the creator copy exactly. The selected route passes because the contrast is proven through repeated visible action: he plans, she initiates, he grounds, she sparks, and the final frame closes the notebook without closing her energy.
golden_theme_machine: universal relationship truth -> concrete Aachu spark -> Zuv steady active response -> tender acceptance thesis
final_public_slide_copy_direction:
Capricorn man
Aries woman

he plans the future.
she starts it.

he says,
"let's think about it."

she says,
"too late."

he makes the plan.
she becomes the plot twist.

he worries in silence.
she fights out loud.

he brings stability.
she brings spark.

he saves screenshots.
she follows instinct.

he acts calm.
but he loves the chaos.

candidates.name: 5-Year Plan Meets Already Left
candidates.universal_truth: Some couples work because one person makes life feel safe and the other makes life begin.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu turns waiting into motion: keys, booking, red-arrow changes, expressive fighting, instinct, balcony dancing.
candidates.zuv_active_role: Zuv plans, grounds, repairs small details, follows her instinct, and quietly enjoys the chaos.
candidates.concrete_proof: chai, notebook, phone calendar, cafe booking, checklist, bracelet fix, map screenshots, closed notebook payoff
candidates.tender_thesis: Somehow, opposite tempos make perfect sense.

candidates.name: Planner x Plot Twist
candidates.universal_truth: The best love story is not one perfect plan; it is the person who keeps making the plan worth changing.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu becomes the playful plot twist in every plan.
candidates.zuv_active_role: Zuv keeps the plan warm instead of rigid.
candidates.concrete_proof: calendar, checklist, heart arrow, travel screenshots
candidates.tender_thesis: He planned the future; she made it alive.

candidates.name: Calm Loves Chaos
candidates.universal_truth: The calm partner is not always surviving the chaos; sometimes they are quietly choosing it.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu dances, initiates, fights out loud, and pulls the day forward.
candidates.zuv_active_role: Zuv watches, softens, follows, and grounds the spark.
candidates.tender_thesis: He acts calm, but he loves the chaos.

candidates.name: Earth Sign Fire Sign
candidates.universal_truth: Stability and spark are not opposites when both people protect the same love.
